submitted.rationale: Highest measured photocurrent (17.6 µA). Its XRD shows the monoclinic BiVO4 reflections (Q≈1.35, 2.03, 2.15) alongside the dominant 2.78 peak. Adding Cu to the BiVO4 region raised photocurrent compared with index 2 (11.8 µA), but going further in Cu-rich, V-poor directions made it collapse (index 92: 0.03 µA).

rejected.reason: Measured 0.03 µA; Cu-rich with Bi about equal to V, past the optimum
XRD shows weak BiVO4 reflections, so not measured
XRD shows an extra phase at Q=1.74 (likely a Cu vanadate), so not measured
